subject.title: fix(wechat): preserve existing accounts across hot reload

question: For the rebased exact head, is redacted live WeChat A+B QR-login evidence required to merge this generic Gateway lifecycle change, or is the focused gateway regression suite plus CI an acceptable waiver?
rationale: The remaining uncertainty is provider-backed behavior that the contributor cannot demonstrate from the current environment; code review cannot safely choose the repository’s proof threshold.

options.title: Require live WeChat proof
options.body: Keep the PR waiting for redacted evidence that logging in account B preserves account A through the real plugin reload path on the exact rebased head.

options.title: Waive provider proof
options.body: Explicitly accept the focused lifecycle regressions and CI as sufficient for this generic handoff, then review the rebased head for merge.

recommendation.title: Require live WeChat proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR waiting for redacted evidence that logging in account B preserves account A through the real plugin reload path on the exact rebased head.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied review timeline specifically routes this gateway PR to joshavant; no stronger current-main ownership evidence was available from the read-only inspection.
